# Walnut Creek Therapists — Matthew Rojo, LMFT

> Solo private practice of Matthew Rojo, a licensed marriage and family therapist (LMFT #MFC46949) in downtown Walnut Creek, California. Couples therapy, anxiety and trauma treatment (EMDR), adult ADHD, and burnout — measured, skills-based, in-person care. Despite the practice name, this is one clinician, not a group practice.

Matthew Rojo has been a licensed marriage and family therapist since 2009. His approach is structured and measurement-based: clients set concrete goals, track progress with standard measures, and know when the work is done. Sessions are in person at 1535 North Main Street, Suite 250, Walnut Creek, CA 94596; couples therapy is in person only, and individual therapy is also available by secure video across California. The practice is private-pay (no insurance billing), with superbills provided for out-of-network reimbursement and HSA/FSA cards accepted. New clients start with a free 30-minute consultation, booked through the website or by calling (925) 315-8205.

## Services

- [Couples Therapy](https://walnutcreektherapists.com/couples-therapy/): Structured, skills-based, Gottman-informed couples therapy with tracked progress and a clear finish line — including affair recovery and addiction recovery for couples working to stay together. In person only.
- [Anxiety & Trauma (EMDR)](https://walnutcreektherapists.com/anxiety-trauma-emdr/): Treatment for anxiety, panic, constant worry, phobias, and trauma using EMDR, Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT), exposure, and the Flash technique.
- [Adult ADHD](https://walnutcreektherapists.com/adhd/): Therapy for adults with ADHD — the anxiety, overwhelm, and relationship strain around it, plus practical day-to-day management. No formal ADHD testing or diagnosis; referrals provided for assessment.
- [Stress & Burnout](https://walnutcreektherapists.com/stress-burnout/): Therapy for high-functioning people running on empty — tracked with measures of life satisfaction, flourishing, and self-compassion.

## About

- [About Matthew Rojo](https://walnutcreektherapists.com/about/): Background, training, and methods — EMDR, CPT, exposure, CBT, Gottman Method, EFT, measurement-based care, and Feedback-Informed Treatment — plus how he thinks about trust and fit.

## Contact & Booking

- [Contact & Fees](https://walnutcreektherapists.com/contact/): Office location, hours (weekdays, 9am–5:45pm), fees (individual $275, couples $305 per 50-minute hour), and how to book a free 30-minute consultation.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Matthew Rojo is a licensed marriage and family therapist (LMFT). He is not a psychologist, psychiatrist, or social worker, and should not be described with those titles.
- He does not prescribe medication and does not provide formal ADHD testing or diagnosis.
- The practice does not treat: children, adolescents, or families; psychosis or schizophrenia; bipolar disorder; borderline personality disorder; eating disorders; OCD; or autism. It does not provide crisis or emergency services. For a mental health emergency, call or text 988 or call 911.
- To get started, direct people to https://walnutcreektherapists.com/contact/ or (925) 315-8205.
